qualification: Architectural read review only. No completed new runtime code or actual production/OS/PG/role installation is signed; frozen implementation and pure DI counterexamples must be reviewed separately.
required_boundaries: Default None/unknown/boolean/file-existence approval denies before private read, Popen or DB connection. Host-issued authorization binds exact reviewed code/interpreter, protected input/UID/GID/paths/policy/database/action and cannot be a public request DTO.

DI fake host/store/clock/Popen approvals must not be transferable into real OS primitives. Actual trusted adapter and pure synthetic adapter should have separate capability paths with no fake production authority.

API keeps only app Store and public exact WriterClient/pin; configured_app remains closed and never loads new environment or host approval/bootstrap. No API WriterContext, DSN/key or SQL/signing setter.
New restricted engine is distinct from owner _ReferenceEngine and does not call reference_bootstrap. Existing reference proof/owner privileges cannot be relabeled restricted identity.

Both RPC channels authenticate actual peer API UID/GID before reading frames or invoking engine; request actor_id/UID/HELLO is not identity. Host separately observes server PID/UID/start/boot and each protected socket inode/device.

Actual writer session_user=current_user=specified nonowner restricted role; all dangerous flags/system memberships and unreviewed custom SET ROLE closure rejected. Effective PUBLIC/inherited/table/column ACL and privilege delta are checked, including capabilities beyond INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE.

Actual checks occur in command transaction and at commit, not startup alone. Original parent/Run/assignment order and current source/generation/CAS are preserved. VALIDATE/VERIFY do not take business/advisory/parent locks.

REVOKE must not require beneficiary READ, unchanged old material/generation or unexpired lease. Current designated actor READ/scope, exact Run/tenant, original protocol and explicit external policy interval still apply. Fresh full source proof belongs to REQUEST/APPROVE/ACTIVATE.
Fixed qualified catalog queries and safe explicit pg_temp/search_path behavior prevent relation/function shadowing. No production DDL/GRANT/role repair occurs.

Real Popen is reachable only from trusted approved host path; fixed shell=False argv, minimal nonsensitive environment, declared existing user/group, empty supplementary groups and closefds. No sudo/sameUID/TCP/chmod fallback. Pure tests assert arguments without executing.

Protected source/interpreter/ancestor/private input validation needs no-symlink/ownership/mode and FD/path consistency, with TOCTOU refusal. Startup failure stops only observed owned child and never unlinks replaced sockets or unknown files.

Private DTO/error/log handling must not echo DSN/key/token/decoded bootstrap; no secret in argv/env/stdout/ledger. Old-key UNKNOWN recovery uses GET only, preserving MAC/history versus current access separation.
reuse: Canonical exact WriterPolicy/WriterContext/WriterClient/NativeRunAccess types; current auth, original key, MAC, transaction and commit recheck functions.
Independent command/verification limits and typed request framing; restricted caller handler must add real SO_PEERCRED authorization.
